annotation.justification: The clause is clear in its requirement: if the application protocol allows data to be carried over the transport after TLS closure, the TLS implementation must receive a "close_notify" alert before signaling end-of-data to the application layer. There is no ambiguity in the wording or in the conditions under which the requirement applies. The clause provides a conditional requirement with a clear trigger and action.
